Policy caps enforced by opal_cue_trace.py: <= 2 concurrent sprite managers (one OBJ palette each), <= 400 concurrent OBJ char tiles (12.5 KiB of the 64 KiB main-OBJ bank), <= 40 concurrent Opal OAM entries (of 128), FX lifetime <= 180 frames, camera cue <= 90 frames.
